verdict.rationale: Eqvista lists a 'Spreadsheet Import' feature and documents cap table migration from Carta, Pulley and spreadsheets, including white-glove migration by its team. That implies bulk loading of historical holdings and transactions rather than entering them one at a time. The evidence shows only feature names and help-article titles, though, with no description of the import format or of batch-issuing new grants. Missing for 10: documented bulk issuance of new grants or options, import template and format details, scope of what transaction types can be imported, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
